name: SEIS
about: Software Engineering and Information Systems, Northeastern College of Engineering. The Northeastern colours and type, with white title and closing slides that carry the SEIS lockup and the unit's name.
sources: The SEIS unit marks supplied by the department (a 463 x 149 lockup and a 160 x 160 tile)
rules: Everything in styles/northeastern/style.json applies here unchanged.
SEIS has no palette of its own. Units may not invent identity colours or marks.
The SEIS lockup is a low-resolution raster (463 x 149). Show it at that size or smaller, on white, on the title and closing slides only. Ask the department for a vector file before using it larger.
Sentence case, no hype, no superlatives the source did not earn.
